mission.title: Catching Up
mission.description: Investigate a break-in and stop the intruders.

npc.say: So, they sent you to stop me, huh? Not likely.

phase.briefing:
Ah, {player}. Your efforts have enabled us to equip many of our operatives with flit guns, and production of both weapons and insecticide proceeds at a great pace.
All I have available for you right now is a standard courier mission. My apologies that I cannot offer anything more... exciting.

enter.say: I can't believe they're sticking you on a courier mission! Ah, well, I guess you gotta take what you can get, right?
Keep an eye out for Agent Norris. You'll be picking up some sort of package from him.

talk.say:
This phase of your mission is terminated. We are registering a break-in at a secure location. Your presence is required there with the utmost urgency.
Leave this area immediately, {player}.
I understand that your presence is required elsewhere, {player}.

complete.say: That's what I'm talkin' about! Some real action!

phase.briefing:
This location houses much of our operational data. It is unclear exactly what information was sought by the intruders.
Search the building and speak with any witnesses to determine the nature of the infraction.

enter.say: Okay, there's a whole bank of computers in here. You'll have to search through those, and interview any witnesses.

complete.say: All right, we've got a list of the compromised data. Get out of there, and we'll see if Gray can analyze it for us.
All right, witnesses! Make sure you find out-- Huh? Oh, uh... my bad. Carry on.

phase.briefing:
This break-in was precisely targeted. The intruders took data referring to the warehouse where flit guns and insecticide are being produced. That location is a high security area; however, the intruders also retrieved the coordinates of one of our security centers.
Travel to the security center. Recover any pertinent data, and stop the intruders if they are still within the location.

enter.say:
Okay, this is the security center. Looks like there's still some activity going on in there... maybe the culprit's still on site!
This break-in was too carefully targeted to be some random redpill... it smells like the Frenchman to me, {player}.
Looks like there are some Machine programs locked in the far room.

done.say: Damn! Looks like they printed out some sort of access card. This can't be good.
That's the last of those Exiles.

complete.say: So, Tifis printed out an access card and took off... I have a feeling Gray'll be giving us the address to that warehouse. Time to get out of here.

phase.briefing:
It would appear that Tifis has proceeded to the warehouse with a fully functional access key. Go there immediately and terminate her with extreme prejudice.
And prepare yourself, {player}. I am certain you will find this fight... challenging.

enter.say: Okay, it looks like Tifis and her team got here just moments ago, and they're still inside. This is your chance to take her down, {player}.

done.say: Nice! Now it's time to get outta there.

mission.finish: Your performance in this matter has been exemplary, {player}. Your actions will allow us to continue production of the flit guns and insecticide.
